methodology: Ground truth was read directly from native Serum 2.0.23 UI state after loading each preset via AbletonMCP create_serum_track. Static numeric readouts were captured with a full-screen .NET GDI screen capture (real file, real SHA256), then cropped to the relevant region (also hashed). No value here was asked of or produced by a VLM -- these are the labels a VLM would later be graded against.

captures.note: sustain=0.16 (normalized) displays as -31.8 dB, not the simple 20*log10(0.16)=-15.9dB one might expect -- consistent with a squared (40*log10) amplitude-to-dB curve for envelope sustain in this build. Recorded as observed, not corrected/assumed.
sustain=1.0 (normalized) displays as 0.0 dB -- confirms the dB curve passes through unity at full sustain, consistent with the note above (40*log10(1.0)=0).

failed_capture_attempts.reason: The tooltip value 'Filter 1 Freq: 172 Hz' WAS observed live through the interactive computer-use automation channel (press-and-hold on the Filter 1 cutoff knob). However, three independent attempts to reproduce that same press-and-hold state from a separate PowerShell process (mouse_event, then SendInput, with and without SetForegroundWindow) never triggered the tooltip in a screen capture taken from that process -- the synthetic input from the scripting channel does not appear to reach the plugin GUI's hit-testing the same way the interactive automation channel's input does. No value or hash was fabricated for this failed capture; the live-observed string is recorded as an unverified/unpersisted observation only, separate from the two confirmed captures above.

scope_note: This is a representative sample (2 controls fully captured, 1 documented failure), not an exhaustive pass over all 330 bulk-causal controls or the full CAL_*/BULK_* preset set. Extending to the full set is straightforward with the same method (create_serum_track -> static full-screen capture -> crop -> hash) for any control whose value is shown without requiring a held tooltip; tooltip-gated controls need the automation-channel gap above resolved first.
